requiredOwnerGates: Verified consistent SQLite backup and restore test
Field mapping and retained provenance review
Row counts, FK checks, unique constraints and sequence alignment
Dry run on authorized backup; compare counts without disclosing records

proposedHandling.ids: Preserve IDs with GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY; reset sequences to max(id) afterward
proposedHandling.passwords: Preserve hashes; never export cleartext passwords
proposedHandling.timestamps: Preserve original timezone semantics; audit UTC before transfer
proposedHandling.verification: Preserve actual states; never promote claims or synthetic flags
proposedHandling.unknowns: Retain unknown hours and missing availability; no invented defaults
